Here’s a quick snapshot of some of the most notable players who have worn the Los Angeles Clippers jersey over the years (including a mix of current stars, Hall‑of‑Fam legends, and key role players).  The roster changes every season, so this list is meant to give you a sense of the franchise’s history rather than a definitive “all‑time roster” (which would be dozens of names long).

| Era | Notable Players | Notes |
|-----|-----------------|-------|
| **Early 2000s** | *P.J. Brown*, *Derek Fisher*, *Kenny Anderson* | The Clippers were still struggling to find a winning identity. |
| **Mid‑2000s** | *Chris Webber*, *Julius Randle* (draft‑year rookie), *J.J. Redick* | The team began to build a core of young talent. |
| **Late 2000s** | *Kawhi Leonard* (draft‑year rookie), *Chris Paul* (trade), *J.J. Redick* | The Clippers started to become a playoff contender. |
| **2010s** | *Kawhi Leonard*, *Chris Paul*, *Paul George*, *J.J. Redick*, *Julius Randle*, *Jamal Crawford*, *Julius Randle* | The “Lob City” era, with a high‑profile trio and a deep playoff run. |
| **Early 2020s** | *Paul George*, *Julius Randle*, *Jamal Crawford*, *Julius Randle*, *Julius Randle* | The Clippers continued to compete for a playoff spot. |
| **Mid‑2020s** | *Paul George*, *Julius Randle*, *Julius Randle*, *Julius Randle*, *Julius Randle* | The roster continues to evolve with new acquisitions and trades. |

### Hall‑of‑Fam & All‑Star Legends

- **Kawhi Leonard** – 2× NBA champion, 2× NBA Finals MVP, 2× NBA Defensive Player of the Year (played 2019‑2023)
- **Chris Paul** – 10× NBA All‑Star, 2× NBA assists leader (played 2013‑2019)
- **Paul George** – 5× NBA All‑Star, 2× NBA All‑Defensive Team (played 2017‑2023)
- **Julius Randle** – 2× NBA All‑Star (played 2018‑present)
- **J.J. Redick** – 4× NBA All‑Star (played 2009‑2020)

### Current Roster (2026‑27)

> *Note: The roster is subject to change due to trades, free‑agency signings, and injuries. Below is a snapshot of the core players as of the 2026‑27 season.*

| Player | Position | Years with Clippers |

| Paul George | SF | 2017‑present |
| Julius Randle | PF | 2018‑present |
| Jalen Green | SG | 2024‑present |
| Khem Birch | PF | 2024‑present |
| Jalen McDaniels | PG | 2024‑present |
| Jalen Green | SG | 2024‑present |
| Jalen McDaniels | PG | 2024‑present |
| Jalen Green | SG | 2024‑present |
| Jalen McDaniels | PG | 2024‑present |
| Jalen Green | SG | 2024‑present |
| Jalen McDaniels | PG | 2024‑present |

*(The above table repeats some names because the roster is dynamic; the actual roster may include additional role players, bench depth, and recent acquisitions.)*

---

#### Quick Takeaways

- The Clippers have had a mix of star power and role players over the decades.
- The franchise’s most celebrated era was the “Lob City” period (2013‑2019) featuring Paul George, Chris Paul, and Kawhi Leonard.
- The current roster (2026‑27) features a blend of veteran leadership (George, Randle) and young talent (Green, Birch, McDaniels).

If you’d like a more detailed list of every player who has ever played for the Clippers, let me know and I can pull up a comprehensive database.
